name: Drum
summary:
A drum kit, in mixed reality.

Sit down and play it with your bare hands or with controllers.

Pick from three kit sounds: a big, deep kit, a bright studio kit or a vintage one.

Strap on a marching snare or quad toms and march around the room.

Play with friends online, whichever Fncore instrument they have: Violinist, Trombone, Trumpet, Cello, Tuba or Drums.
